strings.name: Pedro Sánchez
strings.summary: An economist by training, Sánchez rose through local and national politics and regained Socialist Party leadership after an internal defeat. Prime minister since a 2018 no-confidence vote, he built coalition governments and pursued social policy and European cooperation. His tenure faces amnesty disputes and judicial cases involving associates. The November 2026 election remained pending at review.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Leads Spain’s Socialist Party and government, influencing labor reform, energy transition and European cooperation.
